description: Frontend audit findings and resolutions from Spectre AI Developer Control. Claude uses this to avoid repeating frontend issues in new code.

rules.rule: Never introduce: 1 todo/fixme comments across 1 files

openIssues.recommendation: Convert to functional components with hooks (useState, useEffect, etc).
Add alt="description" to all tags. Use alt="" for decorative images.
Use React Router navigate() or useNavigate() for SPA navigation.

openIssues.issue: 2 files appear to use Tailwind CSS classes
openIssues.recommendation: Replace Tailwind utilities with CSS custom properties and component stylesheets.

openIssues.issue: 11 files may call setState during render
openIssues.recommendation: Move state updates into useEffect, event handlers, or callbacks.

openIssues.issue: 56 files have useEffect without dependency array
21 files have icon-only buttons without accessible name
openIssues.recommendation: Add aria-label or title to buttons that only contain icons.

openIssues.issue: 58 files have <input> without label or aria-label
openIssues.recommendation: Associate inputs with <label> or add aria-label.
Split into smaller focused components. Extract hooks and utilities.

openIssues.issue: 120 files have excessive inline objects in JSX
openIssues.recommendation: Extract inline styles to constants or CSS classes.
Resolve TODO items or move to a task tracker. Stale TODOs become noise.

openIssues.issue: 24 files have large commented-out code blocks
openIssues.recommendation: Delete commented-out code. Use git to recover if needed.
Increase specificity instead of using !important. Use BEM or component-scoped styles.

openIssues.issue: 65 CSS files have no responsive breakpoints

openIssues.recommendation: Always specify type: type="text", type="email", type="number", etc.
Remove or replace with conditional logging: if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.log(...)
